title: Habit Arcade
unlocks: streak shields that protect your habits, and new avatars

games.name: Ice Rescue
games.how: Flip the ice blocks and match each habit to its emoji to free the cubes.
games.teaches: Picture your habits clearly and they're easier to do.

games.name: Memory Loop
games.how: Watch the loop light up, then repeat it. It gets longer each time.
games.teaches: Working memory grows with gentle, regular practice.

games.name: Habit Match
games.how: Match each habit to the benefit it builds.
games.teaches: Knowing why helps you keep going on the hard days.

games.name: Routine Builder
games.how: Put the routine in the order that makes it stick.
games.teaches: Habit stacking: hook a new habit onto one you already do.

games.name: Focus Flow
games.how: Catch the focus boosters, dodge the distractions.
games.teaches: Distractions you can see are distractions you'll reach for.

games.name: Streak Sprint
games.how: Does this make the habit easier or harder? Sort it fast.
games.teaches: Design your surroundings so the good choice is the easy one.

games.name: Daily Dash
games.how: Rapid habit facts. How many can you get?
games.teaches: What the research says about building habits.

games.name: Consistency Climb
games.how: Drop each ice block to build the tallest tower you can.
games.teaches: Consistency beats intensity: small reps stack up.
